titleEn: Yarn Geometries, Fabric Physical Properties & Laundering
titleAr: هندسة الخيوط والخصائص الفيزيائية للأقمشة والعناية بالغسيل

lines.speaker: Omar

lines.text: Never use harsh chlorine bleach on delicate woolens or colored silks.

lines.text: After washing, do not tumble dry knitted sweaters; always reshape them to line dry flat.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Treat accidental grease and wine spills immediately using targeted enzyme stain removal.

lines.speaker: Adam

titleEn: Terroir, Cultivation & Signature Grape Varietals
titleAr: التربة والمناخ والزراعة وأصناف العنب المميزة

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Our terraced hillside slope captures optimal sunlight, giving this unique terroir an exceptional mineral character across every vineyard row.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: We train each delicate vine along a sturdy vertical trellis to ensure maximum sun exposure for our prized Cabernet Sauvignon and velvety Merlot.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Further down the cooler microclimate, vibrant Chardonnay and delicate Pinot Noir flourish alongside aromatic Sauvignon Blanc.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: In the gravelly sector, hearty Riesling and spicy Syrah thrive, while high-altitude plots yield robust Argentine Malbec.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: We also cultivate Spanish Tempranillo and bold, heritage Zinfandel to craft deeply nuanced single-estate vintages.

titleEn: Viticultural Lifecycle, Canopy Management & Harvest
titleAr: دورة حياة الكروم وإدارة المجموع الخضري وموسم الحصاد

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: During winter dormancy, vineyard workers perform meticulous vine pruning and practice grafting on hardy root-stock to sustain healthy vines.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: With spring warming, delicate bud-break signals early flowering and the start of a vigorous growing season.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: We deploy active frost-protection sprinklers and automated drip irrigation to safeguard the lush vegetative canopy.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Protective overhead bird netting preserves grape clusters as veraison transforms green berries into deep purple jewels.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: When sugar levels peak, the harvest commences with careful hand-picking, rushing prime clusters straight to the crush pad.

titleEn: The Estate Team, Enology & Distribution
titleAr: فريق المزرعة وعلم الخمور وشبكات التوزيع

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Our head viticulturist coordinates closely with the vineyard manager to monitor vine nutrition and soil health.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: At dawn, an experienced seasonal harvest crew gathers the fruit while our master cooper repairs toasted oak casks.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Inside the laboratory, the resident enologist tests sugar chemistry, advising our chief winemaker and visionary vintner.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Down in the barrels, the seasoned cellar master oversees barrel aging before releasing lots to a distinguished Bordeaux négociant.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Finally, our resident head sommelier curates prestigious pairings and presents these cellar reserves to visiting connoisseurs.

titleEn: Primary Vinification, Extraction & Clarification
titleAr: صناعة النبيذ الأولية والاستخلاص والترويق

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Gentle grape crushing inside an industrial crusher releases fresh free-run juice, followed by pressing inside a modern pneumatic wine-press.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Cooling jackets on each stainless-steel-tank stabilize temperature while extended maceration extracts deep pigment and phenolic structure.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Yeast converts natural grape sugars during active fermentation within the insulated fermentation-tank.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Meticulous barrel racking separates sediment, followed by protein fining and sterile filtering before maturation in a toasted oak-barrel.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Our enologists complete artistic cuvée blending after months of aging, sending the vintage directly to automated bottling.

titleEn: Enological Equipment, Oak Aging & Maturation
titleAr: المعدات المعملية والتعميق بالبراميل الخشبية والنضج

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: A mechanized destemmer eliminates bitter stalks before a sanitary wine pump transfers whole berries into stainless tanks.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Lab technicians float a calibrated hydrometer to check sugar density and use an electronic pH-meter to monitor chemical balance.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Coopers compare fine-grained French oak with sweet American oak, applying gentle thermal toasting or an intense dark char.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Aging wine in a new barrel infuses bold baking spice, while neutral rest in a seasoned used barrel preserves delicate fruit.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Controlled micro-oxidation softens harsh tannins during sur-lie aging, where weekly bâtonnage stirs fine lees until the corking-machine seals the vintage.

titleEn: Wine Classifications, Effervescence & Fortification
titleAr: تصنيفات النبيذ والفوار والمعزز والحلو

lines.text: Our portfolio spans full-bodied tannic red wine, crisp unoaked white wine, and refreshing pale Provence rosé.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Secondary bottle fermentation produces effervescent sparkling wine with lively streams of persistent fine bubbles.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Prolonged white skin maceration crafts amber orange wine, whereas biodynamic growers bottle unclarified natural wine without additives.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Late-harvest botrytis creates luscious dessert wine, while freezing winter temperatures yield intensely concentrated ice wine.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: In the Douro tradition, distillers add brandy to halt fermentation, producing luscious Port and classic fortified wine.

titleAr: العصر الذهبي ووصفات الكوكتيل الكلاسيكية التاريخية

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Heritage cocktail history revolves around the dry gin martini, bitters-scented old-fashioned, and rye manhattan.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Italian aperitivo culture birthed the bitter negroni, while Caribbean rum powers the tart daiquiri and refreshing mint mojito.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Agave spirit headlines the salted margarita, while rich bourbon and egg white froth define the classic whiskey-sour.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Sophisticated standards include the cognac sidecar, absinthe-rinsed sazerac, and tart cranberry cosmopolitan.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Guests also enjoy creamy piña-colada, potent long-island-iced-tea, copper-mug moscow-mule, and lime-drenched gimlet.

titleEn: Modern Favourites & Technical Mixology Verbs
titleAr: المشروبات المعاصرة والمصطلحات التقنية للتحضير

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Popular modern orders feature a fizzy tom-collins, grapefruit paloma, and effervescent prosecco aperol-spritz.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Patrons love an invigorating vodka espresso-martini or a spicy Bermuda dark-and-stormy with fiery ginger beer.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Clear spirit drinks are quietly stirred, while citrus libations are vigorously shaken, strained, and double-strained into coupes.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Aromatic herbs are gently muddled, tall drinks are carefully built over ice, and tropical drinks are smoothly blended.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: We present artfully layered cordials, spirits subtly infused with botanicals, and flamed citrus peels for theatrical aroma.

titleEn: Order Specifications, Service Temperatures & Tiers
titleAr: مواصفات الطلب ودرجات حرارة التقديم ومستويات المشروبات

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Single malt connoisseurs request their whiskey served unadorned and completely neat at room temperature.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: You can enjoy your favorite spirit poured on-the-rocks over clear ice or chilled and served straight-up in stemware.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: When ordering a martini, clarify whether you prefer a whisper of vermouth in a dry pour or a richer wet balance.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Olive brine creates a savory dirty martini, while mindful guests can request an alcohol-free virgin cocktail.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Choose an economical speed-rail well-drink, or indulge in vintage top-shelf bottles and our barrel-aged house-special.

titleEn: Hospitality Venues, Atmosphere & Ordering Rituals
titleAr: أماكن الضيافة والأجواء وطقوس طلب المشروبات

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Social options range from a bustling sports-bar and unpretentious dive-bar to a quiet wine-bar and secret vintage speakeasy.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Catch the sunset at a breezy rooftop-bar or escape into tropical island escapism inside a bamboo-lined tiki-bar.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Locals meet at the neighborhood pub, an old timber tavern, or an on-site craft brewpub pouring fresh ales.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Colleagues gather in a relaxed hotel lounge for happy-hour specials, opening a shared tab and purchasing a round-of-drinks.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: When the staff announces last-call, settle your credit tab promptly and reward excellent service with a gracious tip.

titleEn: Barroom Entertainment, Social Games & Celebrations
titleAr: الترفيه وألعاب الحانات والاحتفالات الاجتماعية

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Friends raise a heartfelt toast and shout 'cheers', expressing gratitude to their responsible designated-driver.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Guests pay a modest entrance cover-charge, put drinks on their bar-tab, and enjoy energetic acoustic live-music.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Weekly events draw crowds for competitive trivia-night, enthusiastic karaoke singing, and a hilarious weekend comedy-night.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Patrons throw darts at the sisal dart-board, sink stripes and solids at the pool-table, or select songs on the glowing jukebox.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Local performers share stories during open-mic, supporters follow the tournament on a big-screen, and dancers fill the dance-floor.

titleEn: Responsible Hospitality, Moderation & Safety
titleAr: الضيافة المسؤولة والاعتدال والسلامة

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Healthy social engagement emphasizes personal moderation, reminding everyone to know-your-limit throughout the evening.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Be sure to eat-before arriving, and pace-yourself steadily by taking an occasional hydrating water-break.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Door security performs a thorough id-check to confirm that every entrant meets the strict adult legal-age requirement.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Attentive bartenders have an ethical duty to cut-off intoxicated patrons, substituting tea or tonic water instead.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Never operate a motor vehicle after socializing; book a smartphone ride-share to ensure a safe, peaceful journey home.

titleEn: Launch Systems, Spacecraft & Inner Planets
titleAr: أنظمة الإطلاق والمركبات الفضائية والكواكب الداخلية

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: On the coastal concrete launch-pad, a massive multistage rocket stands upright with an auxiliary solid fuel booster.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Engineers enclose the science payload within protective fairings, mounting the crew escape capsule on top.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Long after the historic space-shuttle fleet retired, modern aerospace firms deploy advanced satellite networks worldwide.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Interplanetary expeditions deploy a solar probe to study the scorching Sun, a stationary surface lander, and an autonomous robotic rover.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Navigators plot trajectories across the inner solar system: cratered Mercury, dense acidic Venus, vibrant Earth, and barren red Mars.

titleEn: Outer Giants, Mission Control & Spacewalk Operations
titleAr: عمالقة الكواكب الخارجية ومركز التحكم والسير في الفضاء

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Flight directors inside mission-control monitor the tense terminal countdown leading up to thunderous liftoff.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: After achieving stable low Earth orbit, deep-space probes swing past our Moon to encounter gas giants Jupiter and majestic Saturn.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Long-range sensors image distant icy Uranus, stormy Neptune, a metallic asteroid, and the dusty tail of an incoming comet.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Dressed in a pressurized spacesuit and gold-coated helmet, an intrepid astronaut steps through the airlock hatch.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Conducting a complex six-hour spacewalk, the flight engineer repairs external solar arrays high above the blue planet.

titleEn: Astrophysics, Cosmic Phenomena & Atmospheric Re-entry
titleAr: الفيزياء الفلكية والظواهر الكونية وإعادة الدخول للغلاف الجوي

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Automated guidance completes laser docking at the station while extending a deployable power solar-panel array.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: An orbital space telescope captures light from a newborn star, an iridescent glowing nebula, and a distant spiral galaxy.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Astrophysicists study the gravitational singularity of a black-hole, cataclysmic supernova explosions, and interstellar cosmic-dust.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Stargazers identify each zodiac constellation, marvel at a blazing meteor streak, photograph polar aurora lights, and watch a solar eclipse.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Upon mission completion, the return capsule endures searing atmospheric re-entry before a triumphant ocean splashdown.

titleEn: Avionics, Propulsion & Thermal Protection Subsystems
titleAr: إلكترونيات الطيران وأنظمة الدفع والعزل الحراري

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Telemetry relays via a high-gain dish antenna synchronized with ground tracking radar stations around the globe.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: The onboard flight computer executes real-time orbital corrections by firing each hydrazine attitude control thruster.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Insulated cryogenic valves channel liquid hydrogen propellant from the primary titanium fuel-tank directly into the engines.

lines.speaker: Layla
lines.text: Specialists manipulate an exterior articulated robotic-arm to transfer microgravity experiment pallets into the orbital laboratory.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.text: Ablative ceramic tiles across the base heat-shield absorb incandescent plasma heat until a massive orange recovery parachute unfurls.
